name: Poste Restante — design language
governing: Every thing gets an address, every address receives letters, every letter is kept, and nothing arrives unless you come for it.
metaphor: Familiar shape, opposite operation. The pub reads as a channel, the letter as a DM — and both refuse the platform's speed.

material.note: Warm paper, warm ink, one seal. The house is warm, not cool. One accent, used at most twice on any surface — the seal, never the page.

roles.--accent: seal wax — the single accent, ≤2 uses per surface

typography.note: Three voices. Serif is the letter (the writer). Sans is the reading (the reader). Mono is the machine (addresses, frames, kickers, metadata).

stacks.--font-display: 'Iowan Old Style', 'Charter', Georgia, 'Times New Roman', serif

voices.display: serif — the letter, the writer's voice. Headings, ledes, signoffs, the whisper's opening line.
voices.body: sans — the reading, the reader's voice. Paragraph text, UI labels, buttons.
voices.mono: the machine — addresses, frames, kickers, kind labels, metadata. Never body prose.

flourish.value: The envelope / the letter is the unit (the object every surface is made of); plural time is the framework (the navigation). Object + frame, not two competing flourishes.

whisper.value: A sidebar presence with a distinct identity — the house's own voice, not another inbox. Surfaced when relevant, quiet when not. Never intrusive.

plural_time.value: Calm and native, never a novelty. The frame rail sits beside the Gregorian timeline; the empty frame is a quiet invitation, not a guilt trip.

pub.value: Included in the reference client as a real screen, distinct from the private mailbox. Shaped like a channel, operates like a pub.

scoping.value: The reference client is a guide, not a bible. Build enough to prove the protocol; leave composition to the user.

interaction.note: Presence not pressure — hold, never ping; visible not sent.
rules: No pings, no badges, no notification counts, no alert tones. The letter waits.
No red for errors anywhere. Errors are ink-secondary grey (--muted), dismissible, calm.
Hover/focus/active states must never reduce text contrast. Move the background by ±0.06–0.12 on the OKLch L channel, or adjust border/shadow/position. Never change the foreground to --muted.
Every focusable element has a clear :focus-visible ring (accent).
Buttons: solid primary inverts to ink on hover; ghost buttons darken border + foreground on hover, never lighten text.
Disabled is the only state allowed to reduce contrast.

letter.note: The atomic unit. Envelope + markdown body. Every surface is made of letters.
rules: A letter reads as a letter, not a chat bubble, not a feed card.
Envelope metadata (from, to, cc, thread, kind, lang, subject, frames) is minimal by default, expandable on demand.
Frames render quietly and legibly on the letter (a quiet frame line under the subject).
Each kind (letter, feed, system, audio, note, task) has a distinct-but-quiet identity — not six loud badges.
The audio letter presents the sound and its transcription as two related letters.
The address is visible on the letter — addressed to a specific person, in a specific room, in a specific work, not generic.

whisper_sidebar.note: The mailbox for the house's own letters. Ghost-card lineage: surface, pick up or ignore, learn.
rules: Never pings, never badges, never counts.
Has a distinct identity — reads as the house's own voice, not another inbox.
Every offer shows its reasoning, expandable ('here's what I was seeing').
Pick-up, ignore, and dismissal are all one-tap, calm, reversible-feeling actions.
Replying ('write back') is the most prominent action on a whisper — the strongest signal.
The correction path is visible and simple; the correction is a letter.

archive_browser.note: Plural time. Gregorian is the index; frames are the way in. The genuinely novel piece.
rules: A user can navigate by frame ('what did we decide in tech week?') and by Gregorian date, and both feel native.
A letter in multiple frames is handled gracefully, not duplicated.
The empty frame / unvisited corner is surfaced as a quiet invitation, not a guilt trip.
A contradiction between two letters in a frame is made visible without the browser picking a side.
Never ranks, never counts, never 'you might also like.'
The plural-time view is the piece that makes the house weird — and it must feel calm, not gimmicky.

address_book.note: The social graph. No follower counts, no feeds — just who you correspond with.
rules: No follower counts, no ranking, no engagement metrics anywhere.
An address renders as a person/entity, not a raw string.
A person's card handles a set of names, not first+last. No gender field; pronouns free text. Plural by default.
One tap from an address to compose a letter.

pub.note: The house's public letters. Shaped like a channel, operates like a pub.
rules: Reads as a shared public space, distinct from the private mailbox.
Refuses channel behaviour: no reactions, no presence dots, no typing indicators, no unread counts.
Letters are posted whole and read at leisure — the slowness is visible in the design.

acceptance: One accent (seal wax), ≤2 uses per screen.
Display and body typefaces differ (serif display / sans body / mono metadata).
No purple gradient wash; no warm beige/cream unless the house metaphor calls for it (it does — warm paper is deliberate).
Hover/focus never lowers contrast; :focus-visible ring present on all controls.
Layout integrity — no overlap, no clipping, no orphaned words.
The reference client proves the protocol — it is a client, not the client.
All five design pieces (letter, mailbox+whisper, archive, address book, pub) are coherent under one design language.
The app is calm: no pings, no badges, no red, no engagement.
The primary flows work end-to-end in the prototype.
